items.html: And then the drop that issues from Aba and Ima in their being clothed within ZA certainly does not return to ascend to the head of ZA, but descends into that screen of Beriah and is given in the secret of Mochin to Aba and Ima of Beriah. And then Aba and Ima of Beriah couple and bequeath crowns and Mochin to their children, ZON of Beriah. And by these Mochin, ZON of Beriah then couple and give birth to the souls of the angels of Yetzirah, for in Yetzirah is the habitation of the angels, as is known.
